implementationNotes: The startup language index preserves names, dates, places, moments, books, pair/edition metadata, backlinks, short lines and story image metadata. Full localized prose and original card objects retain their content-hashed URLs. Failed loads can be retried; concurrent loads are deduplicated.

Roots artists and full musical-element content load on opening Roots. Startup retains element names needed by Workshop links. Descent and signature prose load as it enters view; measured mobile layout updates once per newly loaded card.
The cover and introduction remain in prerendered HTML. A language-aware preload starts the compact index before the application module graph finishes downloading.

Small normal/italic cover fonts use separate fallback family names; full variable faces keep their original families and load when reading or interacting. All faces use font-display: swap. Only the shared Fraunces cover face is preloaded; special-project pages retain full typography and omit that cover preload.

Literata latin was used for Latin characters, digits and punctuation even on Russian pages. Fraunces remains necessary for the Sankofa wordmark. Fraunces latin-ext is present in the recorded round-1 EN requests (the static opener contains Pavić), but absent from its RU request list and from a fresh RU baseline reproduction.
The first jump into the story is anchored during font swapping so layout changes do not leave smooth scrolling short of its target.

The hero has 480/960/1600px WebP variants at quality 25 and low fetch priority. The phone picture source is capped at 960px even at high device pixel ratios. The original image and its credit remain available.
